data.title: 爱宕 · 缘侧廊下的惬意掏耳
data.description: 夏日午后的和风走廊，微风拂动庭院竹叶。爱宕端坐于木地板上让你枕在大腿上，手中轻捏细长竹掏耳勺，金眸专注而柔和地垂视着你，黑色犬耳随微风轻颤。
data.location: traditional wooden veranda overlooking Japanese garden
data.action: sitting seiza on tatami giving lap pillow, holding ear pick with tender focused gaze, dog ears twitching affectionately, warm summer breeze
data.lighting: soft dappled garden shade with warm sunlight on deck
data.mood: peaceful healing tranquility, supreme comfort, romantic indulgence
data.promptProse: Giving a relaxing lap pillow on a wooden veranda, Atago gently cleans partner ears with focused affection as a summer breeze blows.
data.animaCaption: Atago giving a soothing lap pillow on a traditional veranda in summer breeze.
